alt: At the round council table a councillor in the white horse-sleeve coat speaks to the blue flame about the dawn his wife came home, while twenty-one-year-old Eulje holds his brush and does not write.

scene: Intimate dutch-tilt two-shot across a low ROUND black council table. At the center, one pale BLUE flame in a small bowl, the only light. Both councillors wear the Harmony Council coat: long white outer robe, wide sleeves embroidered with galloping black horses, plum-magenta inner robe at collar and cuffs, bare topknots, no hats. One, middle-aged, hollow-eyed, speaks with his gaze locked on the blue flame. Across the table an older white-bearded councillor has turned his face away, the last wooden vote piece closed in his fist. At the rim, Eulje, twenty-one, holds a brush and does not write: FACE STRUCTURE from the LEFT portrait only, but YOUNG — black hair, clean-shaven, smooth skin, NO grey, NO beard, do not copy the portrait's age. Plain dark clerk robe. Crushed black beyond the flame. Shame and anger. No crowds.

at: Six pieces go to the no side.

scene: High overhead shot straight down onto a low ROUND black council table. At the exact center, a small bowl with one pale BLUE flame. Six lacquered cups in a ring, six wooden vote pieces gathered on ONE side, none on the other. Around the rim, the sleeves of the Harmony Council coat: white silk embroidered with galloping black horses, plum-magenta inner cuffs. At the bottom edge, Eulje’s young hand and a writing brush, and just beyond the table a spilled wine cup and a gold dancer’s hairpin on the threshold. His face, if it shows, is twenty-one: FACE STRUCTURE from the LEFT portrait only, YOUNG, black hair, clean-shaven, NO grey, NO beard. Crushed black around the blue flame. Quiet, final. No text.
